The tweet is from the official Disney Studios Twitter account (@DisneyStudios) and was posted 7 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The text reads: "✨ Greta Lee and Jodie Turner-Smith have entered the Grid. TRON: ARES is in theaters now. 📸: Derrick Freske" The image includes two side-by-side portraits of the actors Greta Lee and Jodie Turner-Smith.
